_about: Byte-level wire pinning for the Quip solver protocol, version 1.
'messages' holds the lower-case hex of the canonical protobuf encoding of one
fully-populated instance of each message. The exact instances live in the
name; a port to another language must rebuild the same instances and compare
Map fields carry exactly one entry. Protobuf does not define an order for map
entries, and prost writes them in HashMap iteration order, so more than one
entry would make the encoding non-canonical and this fixture unstable.
'enums' pins the number of every variant. Reordering an enum is
source-compatible and wire-incompatible: an old peer keeps sending the old
number, which now means something else.
These bytes were generated from the checked-in prost stubs. Changing them is
a protocol change: update every language's fixture in the same commit.
